title: HB0801 (111th General Assembly): As introduced, creates a Class A misdemeanor of leaving a firearm or firearm ammunition unattended or with a person under 18 years of age in a motor vehicle or boat, if the firearm is not locked within a trunk, glove box, or interior of the person's motor vehicle or boat; punishable only by fine of at least $500. - Amends TCA Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(g)(1)): (1) It is an offense for a person to leave a firearm, loaded firearm, or firearm ammunition in a motor vehicle or boat that is unattended or with a person under eighteen (18) years of age if the firearm is not locked within the trunk, glove box, or interior of the person's motor vehicle or boat, or in a container securely affixed to such motor vehicle or boat.
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307(g)(2)): (2) A violation of subdivision (g)(1) is a Class A misdemeanor. Notwithstanding the authorized punishment for a Class A misdemeanor established in § 40-35-111(e)(1), a violation of subdivision (g)(1) is punishable only by a fine of not less than five hundred dollars ($500).
